tasting_notes: Nose: Dominant rich red fruit notes and gentle oak, followed by warm caramel and fresh lemon. Palate: Light fruity sherry sweetness, rich fruits, and dark chocolate with subtle oak. Finish: Dark chocolate, tobacco and oak.
Nose: Red dried fruits, ginger, oak with gentle minerality. Palate: Light bodied, rich red wine, dry oak, and vanilla. Finish: Dried fruits and wine with dark raisins.
Nose: Smoky, earthy with vanilla and oak, hint of lemon. Palate: Vanilla sweetness, delicate peat, light spice, ginger and lemon. Finish: Long, peat coats the mouth with oak and lemon.
Nose: Toasted walnuts and oak with lavender, cloves, and pomegranate wine funk. Palate: Moreish and pastry-like with soft fruity tannins. Finish: Baked apples and chocolate with peppery cloves.
